name: Skigebiet Heiligenblut-Großglockner
description: The Grossglockner/Heiligenblut ski resort offers 55 km of slopes, 1,500 hectares of freeride terrain, 11 modern lifts, and breathtaking high-alpine scenery beneath Austria’s highest mountain. With guaranteed snow, minimal lift queues, family-friendly facilities, expert ski instruction, and exciting winter events, it delivers a relaxed, authentic skiing experience for all ability levels.
